And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Kumar Singh,Atul Kumar Mishra,Chandra Shekhar Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned Aga for the State.

2.  The present application has been filed with the prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 17.08.2024 in Case Crime No.404 of 2023 under Sectons 406, 420, 504, 506 IPC, P.S.- Dubagga, District- Lucknow as well as summoning order dated 23.08.2024 passed by Additional Judicial Magistrate-VI, Lucknow.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants are innocent persons and have been falsely implicated in the present case.

He further submits thatthe present controversy is related Shashi And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152030544/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: to the civil dispute between the parties, as recorded tenure holder/father of applicant no.2 died on 31.01.2018 and by giving threat, sale deed was obtained from applicant no.2 by respondent no.2 on 15.07.2019 with the sale consideration of Rs.7,50,000/- but not even a single penny has been given to the applicants.

He next submits that only with the intention to make pressure on the applicants,
FIR of case in question was lodged by the respondent no.2 on 27.11.2023, thereafter, charge sheet was prepared by the Investigating Officer on 16.02.2024.

He also submits that application for further investigation was moved by the applicants which was allowed by Deputy Commissioner of Police, Lucknow, and after further investigation, again, on 19.08.2024, charge-sheet was submitted by the Investigating Officer without considering the evidences provided by the applicants, therefore,
kind indulgence of this Court is necessary.
4. Learned AGA vehemently opposes the prayer of applicants and submits that it is admitted case of the applicants that recorded tenure holder/father of applicant no.1 died on 31.01.2018 and property was sold out by applicant no.2 on 15.07.2019 with the sale consideration of Rs.7,50,000/- and all these facts were rightly considered by the Investigating Officer, therefore, defence of the applicants cannot be considered at this stage.
He also relies on the decision of Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of CBI Vs. Aryan Singh reported in 2023 SCC Online SC 379 and submits that the present application is liable to be rejected.

entities.text: CBI Vs. Aryan Singh reported in 2023 SCC Online SC 379
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, going through the contents of application as well as other relevant documents, as it is evident that twice, the investigation was conducted by the Police and charge sheet was submitted, it is also evident that on 15.07.2019, sale deed was executed by applicant no.2 but no FIR was lodged by him with the allegation that sale deed was obtained by giving threat, therefore, the present application is misconceived and liable to be dismissed.
6. In view of the above, present application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. is hereby dismissed.
